newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Van der Horst says awarded pipeline deal.
newsitem.headline: Van der Horst says awarded pipeline deal.

text.p: Van der Horst Ltd said on Monday it had been awarded an Indonesian pipeline deal for US$75.2 million.
It said in a statement the group had won the award to build an extension to an oil depot, a new terminal and the adjoining pipelines on the island of Bali.
The depot and the terminal will supply fuel through the multi-product pipeline covering a maximum length of 68 kilometres for consumption in Sanggaran and th surrounding region.
The contract had been awarded to Van der Horst Pte Ltd's wholly-owned units Van der Horst Technologies Pte Ltd, PT VDH Teguh Sakti and Infrastructure Technologies International Inc.
The project was commissioned by PT Ganergi Gema Sukses, a private company in Indonesia, it said.
The project was expected to contribute positively to the group's earnings for the year ending September 30, 1997.
The projects would be funded from internal resources and by debt financing, it said.
